messages:
Sofia: Heads-up — Kestrel Health renewal next Wed. They're seeing a spike in webhook failures from our v2 endpoint (~5% error rate over last 3 days). CS ticket #4521. Can eng triage and propose a small patch to the backoff/retry logic? @Ravi any capacity to take this today?

Ravi: I can take a look this morning. Can you drop a failing log sample and the payload size distribution? My hunch is downstream 502s, but need data.

Kim: Logs pasted below — lots of repeated 502s then short 429 bursts after retries. They also enabled batching on their side yesterday.

```
[2026-03-12T09:14:21Z] request_id=abc123 upstream_status=502 path=/v2/webhook payload_size=18kb
[2026-03-12T09:14:21Z] request_id=abc124 upstream_status=502 path=/v2/webhook payload_size=19kb
[2026-03-12T09:14:22Z] request_id=abc125 upstream_status=429 path=/v2/webhook payload_size=45kb
```

Kim: CS note: renewal meeting Fri 11am PT. If we can't fix quickly we'll propose temporary routing to v1 + stricter alerting.

Marco: If it's retry/backoff related I can propose a minimal change: move from linear backoff to exponential + jitter so we avoid synchronized retries. Example change in gateway retry.js: `backoffMs = Math.min(2000, base * attempts)` -> `backoffMs = Math.min(5000, base * Math.pow(2, attempts) + Math.floor(Math.random()*200))`. Small, low-risk. I can open a PR.

Ravi: Sounds reasonable. Please add unit test for max backoff and a smoke script to simulate 100 concurrent requests with the sample payload. @deploy-bot can we run a short canary on dedicated/nyc once PR merges? Need 1h at 2% traffic.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary — target: dedicated/nyc, duration: 1h, traffic: 2%, run_id: canary-2629501321. Will report metrics to the rollout dashboard.

Marco: Opening PR now: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/1287 (retry: exponential + jitter). PR title: "retry: add exponential backoff + jitter for v2 webhooks" — small diff, adds smoke script ./tools/smoke/webhook_retry_test.sh.

Ravi: Reviewing. Leaving a few comments about making jitter seedable and adding a short integration step for the smoke test. I'll try to get the review done by EOD.

Kim: Thanks — prepping customer note and fallback instructions for the renewal meeting. If PR lands & canary looks green we can tell Kestrel we pushed a targeted stability fix and will monitor.

Sofia: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround. Flagging as high impact/renewal risk. Will follow up with meeting invite and the CS playbook for rollback if needed. :thumbsup:
